about: A2: how a NoPaper slot label reads as an element of the law. Ordered rules; the first whose `when` holds decides. Features computed by engine/mapping_rules.py from the slot: label (normalised), family, drawn, specialty, group_project. Derived from the governance log (mapping_lexicon and mapping_rule assertions): never edit by hand; rebuild with `python engine/mapping_rules.py --build`.
